experiment: token traces and gate error on ERA (training split)
view: encoder view as in X0 (uint8 512x512), fp32 vision tower + connector, TF32 off
gate: reference-mode pixel gate as in X0 (keep counts asserted equal to X0's per clip)

tiers.A: stale input: dense encoder on the gate's reference image (a floor)
tiers.B: stale rows (G1 option 1): pixel mask held through all layers, unrefreshed rows cached
tiers.C: token-delta gates before q/k/v and before the MLP at every layer, exact attention for all rows (G2-style gating with design option 3); true frames, no pixel gate

tier_c_cost: estimated FLOP share of the dense encoder layers (cost model in bench/tokens_era.py: q/k/v 3, attention 2.67 x k1(3 - 2 k1) capped at 1 (exact update), output projection 1 dense, MLP 8, in N*d^2 units); its minimum is 1/14.7 = 0.068 because the output projection stays dense
error: per-token relative error ||x - x_dense|| / ||x_dense||, mean over tokens then samples then clips
stream: connector output at 24 fps, each method holding its latest output; mean over frames of the token-mean error (token_median: of the token-median error); hold 'first' = first frame held
cost_note: tier A is plotted at the pixel mask's cost, which no kernel achieves (it recomputes every token on the reference image)
cost: full-frame equivalents per second of video (keep x sampling fps); hold baseline costs its fps
equal_cost: per clip, gate stream error minus dense-and-hold stream error at the gate's cost, the hold error taken on the chord (linear in cost) between the strides run, which dropping a fraction of frames or mixing two strides achieves; pooled over clips (median, p10, p90, min, max); gate_lower = clips where the gate's error is lower; clips whose gate cost is below the first-frame-only cost are left out (n). B_first_half: stale rows and hold both over the first half of each clip only (cost from the whole clip). The cost axis flatters the gates: tier A's cost is unachievable, tier C's is a FLOP share without fixed costs
trace: per-token relative change vs the previous sample (understates a gate); layer 0 = embedding, 1-12 = encoder layers, 13 = post-layernorm; inside/outside = pixel block MAD above/below 8
sample: 12 clips per group, random.Random(2), plus hand-labelled still clips the hover rule rejected
